description: Send one bug or feature report about a site path to the Starcovery team. The report records the path and whether the caller sent a credential, never the account. Each user, or each IP for a caller without a credential, may send only a few reports per hour; past that it returns a tool error. Returns the report reference.

body.description: What went wrong, or what is wanted, in the reporter words

path.description: The site path the report concerns, such as /app/lists

title.description: A short title for the report

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
